premises.text: New technology creates new risks for children online
premises.evidence_span: the reality is that new technology creates new risks

premises.text: Parents currently have limited options to monitor their children's online activity
premises.evidence_span: my only options are to pick up his phone, scan through his messages, or to save his passwords and randomly spot check his activity online

premises.text: Parents need a smarter solution to help keep their children safe online
premises.evidence_span: that's exactly why we created Bark

premises.text: Machine learning algorithms can detect issues like cyberbullying and signs of depression
premises.evidence_span: we've developed machine learning based algorithms to detect issues like cyber bullying, sexting, signs of depression, or suicide

premises.text: Bark provides alerts to parents about potential issues without giving unfettered access to children's messages
premises.evidence_span: Bark does not provide a parent unfettered access to a child's messages, only potential problems

premises.text: Parents can configure notification types based on their child's age
premises.evidence_span: we heard from parents of 17 year olds that they want to be notified of different types of issues than that of an 11 year old

premises.text: Bark has analyzed over a million messages and found that many children have had issues
premises.evidence_span: we've analyzed over a million messages, and we've found that just over half of children connected to Bark have had at least one issue

premises.text: Bark's pricing model allows unlimited children and accounts for a flat fee
premises.evidence_span: Bark is just $9 per month per family, unlimited children, unlimited connected accounts

premises.text: Bark collaborates with schools and nonprofits for affiliate revenue
premises.evidence_span: working directly with schools and nonprofits to provide them affiliate revenue

value.text: Children can be kept safe online while maintaining their privacy
value.evidence_span: Our mission is to keep children safe online while allowing them privacy and helping their families build trust in that process

notes: No traction metrics or external partnerships coded as premises.
